item.title: Show HN: Bashbots - program bots in Python to battle other players (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: Almost two and a half years ago, I had an idea for a game where you program Python bots to battle each other. Today I'm finally sharing it with you all (which is a little nerve-wracking): https://bashbots.io On the site, you can watch bashes (battles between bots), browse the equipment upgrades, check out packages other players have published, read the operations manual, and start writing code in the editor. Creating and running your own bot needs a free account (email, Google, or GitHub), since bots run on the server. The full site is built for desktop, and mobile has bashes and the manual. If you'd like a walkthrough, I made a short video series on building your first bot: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdIHqbLcMqVI If you want a challenge, see if you can beat my own bot: https://bashbots.io/bots/b33-p I'd love to hear what you all think. Thanks for taking a look! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50590215 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

item.title: Ask HN: I have been unemployed for 2y. 15 years of experience, US. What to do? (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: I'm Senior software engineer in the US (DMV area), with 15y of experience. Worked for Fortune 50+ company and bunch of mid-size companies. Been unemployed for 2y and can't find a job, within those 2 years, I pretty much spent my savings that I've saved through years, maybe have 4-5 months left to support my household. Currently, I tutor math and probably about to start working as manager in pizzaria. In Jan 2025, I quit from a mid-size insurance tech company(1000+) after working there for almost 4y, because I was tipped off the they were about to start layoffs and they did. Well, since then I have zero luck finding any job in SWE. At this point, I have massive gap in my resume that I can't explain to recruiters, I can still code (C#/.NET/AWS) and learned the AI, but who cares if date of my last employment is Jan2025. What should I do ? If you have an alternative path (something completely different from SWE or SWE adjacent) that pays "well", I would like to hear. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50583761 Points: 376 # Comments: 391
